scores.tell: Binocular head is a fat, soft-cornered blob with a toy face-like front. The yoke arms are thick and the post is chunky. The plate is slightly pillowy.
Planks and posts have straight runs and crisp edges. The life ring is the right thickness. The post tops are a little rounded.
Planet and ring are simple, and the ring is thin and flat. Proportions are slightly toy-like but fit the real cards.
The ball is a plain sphere with slightly uneven patches. Its volume is a bit puffy and the panels are soft.
The calculator body is a pillowy slab with very soft corners, and the keys are swollen. It is close to the real towel's softness.
The helmet is a fat, round bubble with a bulging visor and a puffy rim. The base is a thick disc. It reads like a toy.
The rope is thick but the coil is plausible. The loop is a uniform tube and the figure-8 layout is slightly stiff.
The boot is a tall, narrow tube with a stiff shaft, and the foot is long and thin. Its proportions are less compact than the real boots. The spur is fine.
The hat's cone is clean and the brim is flat. The buckle is the right size. The brim edge is a little thick.
The club head has a flat face and a thin shaft, and the ball is round. The club head is slightly bulky.
